phase: slice 1 (ISO BMFF MOV/MP4 muxer) pushed a922e2e; slice 2 (export queue) in progress

commits.subject: reel (SMB-REEL-ENCODE slice 1): ISO BMFF writer for MP4 and MOV

capabilities_done: (1) reel src/mux.rs Muxer<W: Write+Seek>: MP4 (isom/iso2/mp41 brands) and MOV (qt) writer; video sample entries av01+av1C (validated by parse_av1c), avc1+avcC REMUX ONLY (validated, SPS+PPS required; D24: reel encodes no H.264), VC-3 AVdn/AVdh (MOV only); colr nclx (MP4) / nclc (MOV), pasp 1:1; PCM audio: QuickTime lpcm sound description v2 (16/24/32-bit signed integer, 32-bit float, little-endian packed) in MOV, ipcm/fpcm + pcmC (ISO/IEC 23003-5) in MP4 (rate <= 65535); streamed mdat behind an 8-byte wide placeholder rewritten as a 64-bit mdat header past 4 GiB, co64 when an offset exceeds 32 bits, moov last; video media timescale = 254016000000/gcd(254016000000, ticks_per_frame) with the matching delta (STU-IO-142; 25 -> 25/1, 29.97 -> 30000/1001, 23.976 -> 24000/1001), refused when not 32-bit; samples in decode order with presentation index, reordered streams get ctts v0 + one-entry elst removing the decode delay; deterministic bytes (creation/modification times 0); MuxReceipt (samples, frames, timescale, delay, mdat payload, file bytes, co64, large_mdat)

(1) STU-VID-062 refusal before encoding: Muxer::new refuses unsupported combinations (mux-mp4-cannot-carry-vc3, mux-mp4-pcm-rate-above-65535, mux-pcm-bit-depth, mux-no-tracks) and hostile bounds (mux-dimensions, mux-zero-dimension, mux-zero-frame-duration, mux-frame-rate-not-representable, mux-pcm-layout, mux-config-bytes) before a byte is written; per-sample bounds (mux-sample-bytes, mux-video-samples, mux-file-bytes, mux-pcm-partial-frame, mux-audio-chunks) checked before the write; mux-pts-not-a-permutation and empty tracks refused at finish

tests.argv: cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-reel --test mux_roundtrip --no-fail-fast; cargo nextest run -p hsk-studio-reel --lib -E 'test(/^mux::/)'

next: slice 1 muxer; slice 2 export queue; slice 3 AV1 encode (rav1e, after the steward sync pins it); slice 4 timeline export glue (harness); slice 5 VC-3 (DNxHD/HR) encode

spec_basis: STU-VID-060 (14-studio-creative-suite.md:24658): 'Video export is a StudioExportRecipe and 14.13 owns the format writers.'

STU-VID-051 (24559): 'Codec implementation is NOT reimplemented natively; it is reached through a declared adapter with a typed capability descriptor stating which containers, codecs, bit depths, chroma subsamplings and colour transfer functions it can decode and encode' + 'An absent adapter yields a determinate MEDIA_CODEC_UNAVAILABLE result naming the codec'; D23 enrichment allows Studio-owned Rust adapters behind the same contract.

STU-VID-062 (25272): 'each supported container declares which codecs, colour metadata, caption streams and timecode tracks it can carry, and that an unsupported combination is refused with a determinate result before encoding starts rather than failing partway.'

STU-VID-064 (25329): 'An export is submitted to a queue, runs without a foreground window, reports determinate progress, is cancellable, and produces a receipt naming the recipe, the source span, the output artifact and the outcome ... Batch export of several sequences or several recipes is one queue with per-item receipts, not a loop the caller drives.'
STU-IO-142 (21106): frame rate stored as ticks per frame against 254,016,000,000 ticks per second.
STU-IO-143 (21126): bitrate facet minimum/target/maximum, encoding mode; hard bounds declared per exporter.
STU-MOT-120 (28014): render queue item = (composition, render settings, one or more output modules).
notes.owner: 14.13 owns the format writers (STU-VID-060/STU-PRO-043); module map: reel = decode/encode media adapters -> muxer, encoders and export queue in hsk-studio-reel; timeline glue (pulse frames via composite + score mixdown) in hsk-studio-harness, which already holds the pulse/composite/render-cpu/reel edges. No new module edge.
lead_decisions: 2026-10-15 lead message: D24 wins over the dispatch: NO H.264 encode and NO HEVC encode (not even behind a feature); recorded by the lead as an Operator item.
2026-10-15 lead message: rav1e =0.8.1 approved, optional behind default-off feature av1-encode, default-features off; manifest pushed only after the steward sync commit that pins it.
